newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian anthrax outbreak said almost over.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian anthrax outbreak said almost over.

text.p: The anthrax outbreak in the Australian state of Victoria was on the verge of being declared over, the state's chief veterinary office Dr Andrew Turner said on Friday.
The number of cattle vaccinated in the Tatura-Stanhope region of the state rose to 77,300 on Thursday.
No new properties had been confirmed with anthrax for eight days, evidence of the success of the vaccination and quarantine programme, he said in a statement.
One cow was diagnosed on Thursday as having died from anthrax, the only confirmed anthrax death in the past four days.
The death occurred on a farm in the infection zone on which a large number of animals had previously died from anthrax, Turner said.
The number of properties confirmed with anthrax remained at 83, while total anthrax deaths now stood at 193.
"The vaccination programme has reached its peak and I believe we are on the verge of being able to announce that the outbreak is over," Turner said.
